channel.title: Morning Mail
channel.description: Stay updated on the latest news and events happening in the RPI community.

item.title: Reminder: Use Your Summer 2026 Block Plan Meal Swipes
item.description: Attention Summer 2026 Block Plan users. This is a friendly reminder to use all of your Summer 2026 meal plan swipes before the end of the day on Friday, August 14. Any unused meal swipes remaining after August 14 will expire and cannot be carried over or refunded.
item.author: Students

item.title: Accepting parcels/mail for 2026 fall semester incoming students.
item.description: The Student Mail Center will accept and hold packages for on-campus residents. Once processed, the student will receive an email with pickup instructions at a parcel locker or the service counter. Additional address and shipping information can be found on the RPI Student Mail Center’s website.
item.author: Community

item.title: Announcing the Raffle Winners for RPI Reads
item.description: Thank you to everyone who participated in our inaugural RPI Reads Program this Summer! Overall, 45 individuals completed the program, including students, staff, faculty, and alumi/ae. Stop by the Folsom or Architecture Library for your next read, and join us in congratulating the raffle winners: (visit library.rpi.edu/news for full announcement)
item.author: Community

item.title: Updates around campus
item.description: You may start to notice some new signs and updates to signage around campus! We’re making a few changes to help create a more welcoming, clear, and easy-to-navigate environment for everyone in our community. As the updates roll out, you may see new signs popping up or some familiar ones being replaced. We’re excited for you to see the changes and appreciate your patience as we work to give our campus a fresh new look! Union Lots: 30-minute parking is available for short-term visits. Sherry Road…

item.title: Upcoming Brief Carousel Signage Outages
item.description: Carousel Signage has notified RPI of two upcoming outages of the Carousel Signage website. During this time all signage will continue to play cached content, however the website will be unavailable briefly for a 10 minute period while the site is updated. Outage 1 - Tuesday August 18 at 5:30pm Outage 2 - Tuesday August 25 between 8pm and 10pm

item.title: Faculty and Staff Quick Learn Webinar: Best Practices for Dealing with Student Absences
item.description: Date: Monday, August 24, 2026 12:00 PM - 12:30 PM - In this workshop we will offer some best practice strategies for dealing with student absences. Maureen Fodera (Office of Undergraduate Education) will be presenting this workshop. Please register using the Event URL in the See section of the calendar event.
item.author: Faculty and Staff

item.title: Updates to the student experience
item.description: As we prepare for the year ahead, you are invited to join us for a campus-wide conversation about updates designed to support and strengthen the student experience on August 19 from 9–11 a.m. at CBIS, Auditorium.
